_comment: Unified config for das_wavefront_picker. SET das_data_dir to a directory of your DAS .h5 files (absolute path, or relative to the app root). Every field can also be overridden on the command line (python run.py detect --help). The values below match the 80 Hz / 16 m demo sample. To run the built-in demo, drop the sample h5 files into das_wavefront_picker/demo_data/ (see README §1) — then das_data_dir can stay empty and demo/selftest auto-detect them.
